name: Text Burstiness v2
description: IQR-based burstiness measurement of sentence lengths (2023)
algorithm: Text Burstiness v2 — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method performs linguistic analysis for AI-generated テキスト detection:

1. **Text Preprocessing**: The input テキスト is tokenized and processed for analysis.

2. **特徴抽出**: IQR-based burstiness measurement of sentence lengths (2023). Relevant linguistic features are computed from the テキスト.

3. **Statistical Analysis**: Features are compared against baseline distributions from human-written vs AI-generated corpora.

4. **Pattern Detection**: Anomalous patterns characteristic of AI generation are identified.

5. **スコア計算**: A confidence score (0-100) is calculated based on detected patterns.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 統計
メディア: テキスト
入力: Raw テキスト string
Minimum テキスト length: 100 characters
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
処理方式: Client-side NLP analysis
accuracy: 中〜高 — 65-85% 単独精度. Performance increases significantly when combined with complementary テキスト analysis methods. Results vary with テキスト length, language, and content type.
source: Statistical NLP analysis methods for AI-generated テキスト detection. Based on computational linguistics and information theory research.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated テキスト through テキスト burstiness v2 analysis. This method examines specific linguistic patterns that differ between human-written and AI-generated テキスト, providing complementary evidence in a multi-method analysis pipeline.
strengths:
• Fast client-side analysis with no server required
• Effective as part of a multi-method analysis pipeline
• Works across various テキスト types and genres
• Based on established linguistic research
• Complements other 統計 テキスト analysis methods
limitations:
• Best used in combination with other テキスト analysis methods
• Performance varies with テキスト length (requires sufficient テキスト)
• May be affected by テキスト language and writing style
• Accuracy depends on the AI model used for generation
• Human writing can occasionally trigger false positives

references.title: Tian, E. (2023). GPTZero: Towards Detection of AI-Generated Text.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
